message.reasoning: Assess. C1: good mission concept, users (marine/conservation scientists), rationale, references. Accomplished, ~8-9. C2: Gantt chart with detailed task descriptions, but no contingency provision; adequate-accomplished. Plan fits mission, references sources. I'd say 7.
